description: Build a multi-panel macro market cockpit that combines FX sessions, upcoming release queue, pair context, and generated risk alerts. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency for pair context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Defaults to the release currency when omitted. Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

currency.description: Release currency used for queue and spotlight indicator. Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

indicator.description: Spotlight indicator slug for release context. Supported examples: catalogue indicator slug, e.g. inflation or policy_rate.

quote.description: Quote currency for pair context, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.
